sourceVerification: All five runtime JavaScript files in the pinned auth0/node-jws source archive exactly match npm jws 4.0.1. The npm gitHead archive at the old repository URL contained only a README; tests use the matching canonical source instead.
changes: Use vjwa and native base64url; remove the safe-buffer dependency.
Require exactly three canonical compact segments and a UTF-8 JSON object header; match the declared algorithm to the explicitly selected algorithm.
Preserve raw byte payloads, accept empty payloads and empty secrets, and honor non-JSON payload decoding encodings.
Collect streamed chunks once, propagate source errors, and complete operations only once after both inputs finish.
Keep bounded, private caches of serialized signing headers and validated parsing metadata; return fresh decoded objects and never cache payloads or keys.
Validate large payload encodings with native canonical base64url round trips.
Provide native readable outputs, legacy input compatibility, cancellation cleanup and optional per-input maxBuffer limits.
Avoid allocating Writable collectors for direct values unless their public input stream is accessed; reject writes to completed inputs before signing.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Run the original 31 tape test bodies against each implementation through a node:test assertion adapter; no test bodies are removed or skipped.
Generate native RSA/EC keys, including an actually encrypted private PEM. Bun uses P-384 for the wrong ES256 curve case because its crypto runtime does not support secp256k1.

For VPM only, replace the invalid-key error case input a.b.c with eyJhbGciOiJFUzUxMiJ9.eA.AA so the token has a valid compact/header structure and reaches key validation. Malformed tokens intentionally return false before importing keys. The retained upstream test source is unchanged.

changes: Replace source-stream Writable/pipe intermediaries with owned data/end/error/close handlers and a shared input state; materialize native Writable inputs only when requested.
Reuse one lazy 64 KiB decoding scratch buffer, cleared in finally after each block, to avoid large validation allocations.

On Node, combine canonical lengths/tail bits, alias/wide-character exclusion and exact native decoded byte counts. Bun retains exact round trips because its Buffer.write treats some invalid ASCII as base64 values.
Retain only immutable algorithm strings in parsing metadata; validate header UTF-8 only when decoding produced a replacement character.
performanceFollowup.validation: Differential canonical-encoding checks cover every byte value, wide-character aliases, surrogates, threshold and scratch-block edges. Tests also cover large binary signatures, HMAC key forms, paused/shared input sources and the original stream lifecycle boundaries.
